about: The HD-2D mode's town kit (docs/HD2D.md §5c): the pieces a town is composed of, drawn by OpenAI's gpt-image-2.5-sunburst through tools/hd2d/gen.py (a sheet a family: `town:<family>`; the landmarks four to a sheet: `landmark:<n>`), cut by `art.py split` and carded by `art.py prop` at `height` art pixels (the cards stand at PX.prop, the prop cards' density). A family's pieces are named town_<family>_<piece>_<n> (house, tower, wall, gate, corner); a civilization's landmark town_lm_<civ>. Saturated royal blue is the owner-colour band (docs/ISO.md §7): the dressing turns it to the owner's colour, so the prompts put it only on what should carry that colour. `civs` lists each family's civilizations (the 3D renderer's architecture.js CIV_FAMILY with its sub-styles made families of their own).
style: 16-bit pixel art game sprites for an HD-2D fantasy strategy map (in the manner of Octopath Traveler and Triangle Strategy): crisp square pixels, a dark coloured one-pixel outline round each object, detailed but readable at small size, muted earthy palette (weathered stone, warm browns, deep olive, slate grey; no neon), windows and doorways glowing warm orange-yellow. Transparent background; no ground plane, no grass base, no terrain, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no border.
view: Camera: a front view from about 30 degrees above the horizon, as a low-tilted map shows a town: every building's front wall faces the viewer squarely, parallel to the bottom of the image, and its roof is seen from above the front; NOT isometric, not turned 45 degrees, no corner pointing at the viewer. Light from the upper left: the left parts and left roof slopes lit, the right parts and the undersides of eaves in shade. Each object stands upright, its foot a straight horizontal line at its bottom.
owner: Saturated royal blue is reserved for the owner's colour: use it ONLY where a piece below names royal blue (roofs, domes, banners, pennants) and nowhere else: no blue glass, water, sky, stone, crystal, light or clothing.
